## File: facebookresearch_fairchem/src/fairchem/core/common/parallelism/graph_partition.py

Prompts

```
['build a python module to partition atoms spatially using Morton Z-order curve across GPU ranks', 'create a function that splits atoms into contiguous chunks across GPU ranks by index', 'build a python module to expand 10-bit integers into 30-bit Morton Z-order codes for spatial indexing', 'review the PartitionStrategy enum to understand INDEX_SPLIT and SPATIAL partitioning options for atom distribution', 'test the partition_atoms_spatial function with atom position tensors to verify balanced rank assignments']
```

Usage

```
{'partition_atoms_spatial_morton': 'build a python module to partition atoms spatially using Morton Z-order curve across GPU ranks', 'partition_atoms_index_split': 'create a function that splits atoms into contiguous chunks across GPU ranks by index', 'expand_bits_morton_code': 'build a python module to expand 10-bit integers into 30-bit Morton Z-order codes for spatial indexing', 'review_partition_strategy_enum': 'review the PartitionStrategy enum to understand INDEX_SPLIT and SPATIAL partitioning options for atom distribution', 'test_spatial_partitioning': 'test the partition_atoms_spatial function with atom position tensors to verify balanced rank assignments'}
```
